attachmentModel.owner: DamageInfo (the damage definition a hit, explosion, beam/arc/spray tick or melee strike applies)
attachmentModel.packing: used slots are contiguous from slot 1; no live DamageInfo row has a gap
attachmentModel.attachmentSlot: the first empty slot of each DamageInfo row; only it is offered, so slots stay packed
attachmentModel.directHitVsExplosion: separate DamageInfo rows: a projectile's direct-hit damage and its explosion damage each have their own four slots
attachmentModel.multipleStatuses: yes, up to four per DamageInfo row (flamethrowers apply fire, fire_panic and flamer_slowed from one row)
attachmentModel.application: per DamageInfo application: every projectile hit, every explosion, every beam / arc / spray tick, every melee strike
attachmentModel.sharedDefinitions: status definitions (duration, tick damage) are global; editing status.duration changes every attack that applies the status
acknowledgements: none for status slots on player and support weapon projectile direct-hit rows (live-proven: LiberatorFireStatus, MaxigunStun; see sdk/LiveEvidenceCatalog.json)
allow_unverified_effect for status slots on every other row (explosion, spray, beam, arc, melee) and on vehicle mounted weapons
allow_shared when the DamageInfo row is shared by several weapons
attachmentModel.effectiveDuration: status.duration is the duration the status definition stores. In game, Stun Medium (3 s) was observed to hold enemies for about 1-2 s; the cause is not established. Enemies carry per-class status susceptibility tables (research/status-susceptibility-F5FEE03DCFDB.json), so target-side processing may shorten it.

attachTiers.player_attack: a mapped player-side attack already applies it through a DamageInfo slot
attachTiers.enemy_slot: The game applies it through DamageInfo status slots on enemy or hazard rows; the slot mechanism is the same on a weapon row, but no weapon applies it in vanilla.
attachTiers.other_system: EXPERIMENTAL: the game never applies it through a DamageInfo slot; its definition is an attack effect (damage over time or a debuff), but whether a slot-applied instance behaves like the game's own is unknown.

attachmentModel.attachPolicy: schemas/status_attachment_policy.json (0.30.2): enemy_slot and other_system statuses need allow_unverified_effect on every row until a live test passes
blocked: adding a fifth status (the slot array is fixed at four)
terrain, stim, weather and system statuses (schemas/status_attachment_policy.json)
removing a status from any but the last used slot (it would leave a gap)
